metadata.description: Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace short name.

connectorUiConfig.title: XdrLogRaider — Defender XDR portal-internal
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Sentinel data connector that harvests the `security.microsoft.com/apiproxy/*` surface Microsoft does not publicly document (Action Center, Configuration, Endpoint Devices, Identity, Multi-Tenant, Secure Score, etc.) using operator-authorised SA TOTP/Passkey sign-in. Card freshness driven by 5-min `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` heartbeat.

sampleQueries.query: Defender_EndpointDevices_CL | where Slug startswith 'endpointdevices-' and Slug contains 'timeline' | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData.DeviceId, ProjectedData.UserPrincipalName, RawJson
Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where Slug == 'actioncenter-listpending' | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData, RawJson
Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where Slug contains 'attacksurface' or Slug contains 'chokepoint' | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData, RawJson

sampleQueries.description: Identity · auth events + cloud identity queries
sampleQueries.query: Defender_Identity_CL | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData.UserPrincipalName, ProjectedData.IpAddress, RawJson

sampleQueries.description: Configuration · suppression rules + critical asset classification
sampleQueries.query: Defender_Configuration_CL | where Slug contains 'suppression' or Slug contains 'criticalasset' | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData, RawJson
Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL | top 50 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData, RawJson
Defender_SecureScore_CL | top 20 by TimeGenerated desc | project TimeGenerated, Slug, StatusCode, ProjectedData, RawJson

sampleQueries.description: Health · auth-fatal events last 12h (connector outage signal)
sampleQueries.query: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where Status == 'AuthFatal' and TimeGenerated > ago(12h) | order by TimeGenerated desc

value: XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where Portal == 'Defender' and TimeGenerated > ago(15m) | take 1
union withsource=TableName isfuzzy=true Defender_*_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) and SuccessKind == 'live' | summarize hits=count() | where hits > 0
XdrConnectorHealth_CL | where Status == 'AuthFatal' and TimeGenerated > ago(4h) | summarize fatals=count() | where fatals == 0

union withsource=TableName isfuzzy=true Defender_*_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize WithPD=countif(isnotempty(ProjectedData)), Total=count() | extend Pct=iff(Total>0, round(100.0*WithPD/Total,1), 0.0) | where Pct >= 20.0

customs.name: Microsoft Defender XDR service account
customs.description: Dedicated SA in your Entra tenant with **Security Reader** + **Microsoft Defender Analyst**, Conditional-Access-exempt for unattended TOTP/Passkey sign-in.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Service account
instructionSteps.description: Create a dedicated Entra user (e.g. `svc-xdrlr@<tenant>.onmicrosoft.com`). Grant **Security Reader + Microsoft Defender Analyst**. Set MFA to TOTP (or Passkey ECDSA-P256) and capture the base32 seed (or PEM). **Conditional Access exemption from interactive-MFA / device-compliance is required** — audit this exemption quarterly per your security policy.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy
instructionSteps.description: Use the **Deploy to Azure** button in the README, or `az deployment group create` with `deploy/mainTemplate.json` + `deploy/createUiDefinition.json`. Provide the workspace ARM ID, SA UPN, password, and TOTP seed (or Passkey PEM). The Function App uses identity-based AzureWebJobsStorage (full SAMI posture · adds ~30-60s to cold-start).

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify
instructionSteps.description:
Within ~20 min the heartbeat lands in `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` and the connector card flips **Connected**. Tables surface in **both** the legacy Azure portal Sentinel UI **and** the new unified Microsoft Defender XDR portal (Sentinel-in-Defender · July 2025+) · same KQL works in both. Run `tools/Smoke-E2E.ps1 -ResourceGroup <rg>` to confirm AC-1..AC-10 and the first TenantContext row is queryable.

**Note**: The `/apiproxy/` surface is portal-internal · **no Microsoft SLA** · breaking changes possible. Azure portal Sentinel UI retires March 31, 2027 · queries continue to work in the unified Defender XDR portal.
